text: {"subject":"Claim C019541: decide whether to bill 32 units instead of 36 for 2026-09-19","body":"Claim C019541 for member PT0014 (service T1005, date of service 2026-09-19) is predicted to deny under D06. It bills 36 units, which would exceed the member's 32-unit daily maximum. The proposed fix is to bill 32 units and reduce the billed amount from 172.80 to 153.60. Please decide whether to bill fewer units for this day before the claim is resubmitted. Note that the units for that day are also drawn by claims C020497 and C020555, which are predicted paid but not confirmed, so the paid-unit count may change. The claim is due for submission in 15 days."}
